reviews.text:
THEY SELL FIRST CLASS PLANTS THAT I BUY EVERY YEAR.
if the DAFFODILS are as good  as last year I shall buy  a lot more,all my friends want them.

I’ve been using this place for years and have previously been happy with the quality and customer service. I popped in recently to grab a tray of marigolds and there was not much going on in the way of bedding plants. When I asked the shop assistant if they had any marigolds, I was barked at abruptly by her to say “no, all gone. Anything we’ve got will be out the back”. I left empty handed and will take my business elsewhere in future.
Amazing groomers. So local for me and Katie is lovely. She does a great job and my dog is really happy going there. He’s not like that with all groomers!
Maomao was nervous when she arrived but came out happy and looking great for Christmas. Thank you!

Really great groomers, my elderly Yorkie Poo got the 5 star treatment during his pamper session, he came home looking great and really happy and relaxed. It was super easy to book in and great customer service. Having tried a few groomers in the local area this was by far the best experience we have had. Oscar has never been so relaxed after coming out of the groomers. I would highly recommend.
Great customer service at the shop today from a very pleasant young man. I believe called Charlie. Thank you again

A few bunches I’ve gotten over the years from pets & gardens personally made by maddi each time I can wholeheartedly say I’d never go elsewhere it’s perfect every single time 100% recommend them if you walk in and see maddi know you’re in great hands
Always nice quality plants and compost

My husband has bought a beautiful arrangement of flowers today. A new service for this lovely plant and pet shop. They are tied and I have just snipped the stems and put them straight in a vase, as I’m no good at arranging flowers , this is a great help. I can recommend this florist. Give them a try 😊 …
5* service and a lovely selection of flowers, my husband surprised me with a lovely bouquet earlier today, i would definitely recommend if you’re in the area.
Excellent plants and flowers and Staff always offer a  friendly service. Would definitely recommend

I can’t recommend Pets and Gardens enough! Their selection of plants is truly exceptional—top quality and carefully curated. Every time I visit, I’m amazed by the variety and health of the plants available. They also provide great advice and support, ensuring I choose the right additions for my garden. Thanks to their fantastic offerings, my garden always looks vibrant and stunning. A must-visit for any gardening enthusiast!
Great little site, lovely choice of plants for the size.

You will be amazed when you walk through the shop you enter a wonder land of trees.plants. pots. Herbs  and so much more. Also pet food and fruit and veg. It's a must visit.

They have some amazing Christmas tress in December

So nice to go to a shop where the staff are so helpful. And give a smile.

The plants are kept in amazing shape.

Need hanging baskets and everything you need. This is the place

Great customer service

You can just pop in  or like me spend 30 mins just looking at everything
